method: Every figure is measured like-for-like from our price price snapshots of Bangladesh phone shops: official against official, import against import, one storage variant against the same variant, and a shop price comparison only across three or more distinct shops.

definitions.tracked: distinct handsets with at least one price ever recorded
definitions.snapshots: nights on which a price read succeeded and wrote rows
definitions.nights: calendar nights from `since` to `until` inclusive; `snapshots` below this means crawls that did not run or did not finish
definitions.in_stock: handsets a shop reports in stock today
definitions.listed: handsets any shop lists today, including delisted records still carrying stock

stories.headline: The Apple iPhone 15 Pro official price is ==৳60,001 more== than it was a month ago
stories.caption:
Everyone tells you to wait, that phones only get cheaper. Here is what waiting a month did to the Apple iPhone 15 Pro's official price.

৳159,999 on 3 September. ৳220,000 today. 112 phones we track cost more now than they did a month ago:

• Apple iPhone 15 Pro: ৳159,999 to ৳220,000 (+38%, official price)
• Google Pixel 9 Pro Fold: ৳134,999 to ৳179,999 (+33%, unofficial price)
• OnePlus 13: ৳75,999 to ৳111,999 (+47%, official price)
• Realme Note 60: ৳11,499 to ৳42,999 (+274%, official price)

That is the cheapest listed price on that channel, read every day or two and plotted above. Full chart:
https://bhalophone.com/phone/apple-iphone-15-pro

Ever waited for a price to fall and watched it climb?

• Today: ৳105,010

stories.headline: The same phone costs ==10.2% more== at GadgetAndGear than at the cheapest shop
stories.caption:
Same phone, same storage, same channel. What does each shop want for it on the same night? We ran that 164 times.

GadgetAndGear came out 10.2% above the cheapest shop on average. GaziElectronics came out 0.7%.

• GaziElectronics: +0.7% (43 comparisons)
• RioInternational: +1.7% (85 comparisons)
• SMSGadget: +3.4% (92 comparisons)
• Pickaboo: +7.8% (78 comparisons)
• AppleGadgets: +7.8% (66 comparisons)
• SumashTech: +9.3% (147 comparisons)
• GadgetAndGear: +10.2% (90 comparisons)

Shops bundle differently and stock different things, so a premium is not proof of anything by itself. But if you are about to spend six figures, the shop you walk into is worth knowing. Checked every day or two, every shop we track:
https://bhalophone.com

Which shop do you actually buy from?

stories.headline: Waiting 114 days on the Apple iPhone 16 Plus saved you ==৳49,999==
stories.caption:
Somebody paid ৳184,999 for a Apple iPhone 16 Plus back on 11 June. It is ৳135,000 today.

৳49,999, for waiting 114 days. The four phones we have watched fall hardest since the first night anyone here quoted a price:

• Apple iPhone 16 Plus: ৳184,999 to ৳135,000, −-27% in 114 days (official price)
• Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra: ৳245,999 to ৳179,999, −-27% in 91 days (official price)
• RedMagic 11S Pro: ৳152,840 to ৳118,999, −-22% in 114 days (unofficial price)
• Honor Magic V6: ৳229,999 to ৳185,999, −-19% in 90 days (unofficial price)

Every line is one channel against itself, so a sold-out listing never reads as a price cut. Night-by-night history:
https://bhalophone.com/phone/apple-iphone-16-plus

Anything you are holding out on? Name it and we will watch it.

stories.headline: Buying the iPhone 17 Pro Max official costs ==৳162,009== more
stories.caption:
Official Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max, 1TB: ৳264,499.
The identical unofficial box: ৳102,490.

৳162,009 is what the official channel costs you on this phone. Both in stock today. The four widest gaps we can price on both channels right now:

• Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max 1TB: official ৳264,499 vs unofficial ৳102,490 (৳162,009 apart)
• Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 5 12GB/256GB: official ৳285,999 vs unofficial ৳123,999 (৳162,000 apart)
• Apple iPhone 17 Pro 1TB: official ৳261,000 vs unofficial ৳102,490 (৳158,510 apart)
• Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 6 12GB/256GB: official ৳197,999 vs unofficial ৳84,999 (৳113,000 apart)

Same storage on both sides, always. Quoting the cheapest official against the cheapest unofficial usually compares 512GB with 256GB and doubles the gap. Specs, shops and the full history:
https://bhalophone.com/phone/apple-iphone-17-pro-max

Official or unofficial: which way did you go, and would you do it again?
